_comment_nul_redirect: Auto-fix: > nul -> > /dev/null (nul creates undeletable files on Windows)
_comment_msys2_drive_paths: Auto-fix: /c/Users/... -> C:/Users/... (MSYS2 paths fail with Windows tools)
_comment_backslash_paths: Auto-fix: C:\Users\... -> C:/Users/... (backslashes break in bash)
_comment_wsl_paths: Auto-fix: /mnt/c/Users/... -> C:/Users/... in Git Bash (left alone when the command invokes wsl)
_comment_reserved_names: Block: > con, touch prn.txt (Windows reserved device names)
_comment_python3: Auto-fix: python3 -> python when python3 is missing or only the Microsoft Store stub
_comment_dir_windows_flags: Auto-fix: dir /b -> ls -1, dir /s -> ls -R (dir in Git Bash is GNU coreutils)
_comment_doubled_flags: Auto-fix: tasklist //fi -> tasklist /fi (doubled // breaks Windows commands)
_comment_dir_in_pwsh: Block: pwsh -Command 'dir /b' -> suggest Get-ChildItem (PowerShell dir != cmd dir)
_comment_pwsh_quoting: Block: a $ in pwsh -Command code that bash expands, unless marked: \$x for pwsh, or a variable assigned earlier in the same command for bash
_comment_powershell_legacy: Block: powershell.exe -> suggest pwsh (full path allowed for PS 5.1)
_comment_wsl_invocation: Block: wsl ... when WSL is not installed (allowed when it is)
_comment_bare_pwsh_cmdlet: Auto-fix: Get-ChildItem -> pwsh -NoProfile -Command 'Get-ChildItem' (wrap bare PS cmdlets)
_comment_windows_env_vars: Auto-fix: $APPDATA -> C:/Users/me/AppData/Roaming (forward-slash Windows path; $HOME-based /c/... paths fail in native programs)
_comment_cmd_cd: Auto-fix: cmd /c build.bat -> cmd /c "cd /d <cwd> && build.bat" (fix CWD inheritance)
_comment_start_command: Auto-fix: start "" "file" -> python os.startfile() (avoids spawning cmd.exe)
_comment_git_commit_attribution: Block: git commit with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming an AI assistant (human co-authors pass)
_comment_git_commit_generated: Block: git commit with a 'Generated with/by <AI tool>' footer
_comment_git_commit_emoji: Block: git commit messages containing emoji
_comment_file_content_unicode: Block: Write/Edit with emoji or decorative unicode (box drawing, dingbats)
